description.desc_thousand_char: Shrinath Rotopack Private Limited (SRPL), as per its credit rating report, is engaged in the business of manufacturing flexible laminated plastic packaging (Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC), Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE), High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), Biaxially-Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP), Biaxially-Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET)) that are used separately or in combination for packaging applications. These packaging solutions are used in the FMCG, confectionery, and food and beverages industry. SRPL has two plants at Mankhal (28,200 MTPA) and Burgul (29,340 MTPA), Hyderabad, having a cumulative capacity of 57,540 MTPA. Apart from this, the company has an in-house cylinder engraving facility of approximately 25,000 cylinders per annum. These cylinders are used as dyes in rotogravure machines. SRPL exports its products to 25+ countries. The company was incorporated in 2006 and has its registered office located in Kattadan, Telangana.
